reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it presents a cryptocurrency purchasing tutorial, showing how to transfer Bitcoin to Mercatox and place a Dogecoin buy order. The creator directs viewers to exchange and cryptocurrency sign-up links and discloses that some links are affiliate links, but the material does not establish a deceptive promise, guaranteed return, impersonation, or concealed money or data diversion. The observed content is educational instruction combined with ordinary affiliate promotion.

that's the first step that you want to do you want to buy your Bitcoin

you'd wanna press deposit on your Bitcoin then you would get an address and then you'd use that address on the Coinbase account or wherever you bought your Bitcoin that's the address you would put in the Send box

opening.argument: The video ties a simple viewer action sequence directly to obtaining a digital asset: buy Bitcoin, create or use an exchange account, deposit the Bitcoin, and place a Dogecoin order. That is more than abstract discussion; it is a concrete acquisition pathway presented as easy and nearly complete. The closing language reinforces the transactional payoff by treating the purchase as success and urging viewers toward additional income activity. The viewer is therefore being steered to convert funds into a crypto asset through the demonstrated flow.

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the walkthrough educational does not remove its solicitation function. The cited instructions are precisely a sequence for acquiring the promoted asset, and the conclusion links the activity to “multiple streams of income.” The absence of an explicit guarantee does not change that viewers are directed to buy, deposit, and trade through the presented route.

citations.quote: now mercatox is a very good alternative to buy altcoins that Binance does not have on their system
the last and final step is to hit the trade button

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The instructions show how to execute a purchase, but they do not show that Dogecoin is free, unusually easy to obtain, or guaranteed to produce a reward. “Congratulations you got some doge” describes completion of a trade, not a promised benefit, and “multiple streams of income” is not tied to a stated Dogecoin return. The evidence therefore shows a tutorial, not the required deceptive acquisition promise.

citations.quote: depending on how much Bitcoin you have in your account you can put in the amount that you want to buy
if you want to buy hundred thousand do's you put it in there

opening.argument: Several risk signals appear together: cryptocurrency purchasing, an exchange deposit workflow, external registration links, affiliate compensation, and broad income language. The description expressly directs viewers to sign up for Mercatox and also promotes Coinbase and a Bitconnect squad, while acknowledging that the links can generate commissions. In the video, the viewer is shown moving from Bitcoin holdings to a Dogecoin buy order, making the promotion operational rather than merely commentary. Taken together, the presentation encourages token participation while surrounding it with income-oriented messaging and monetized referrals.

citations.quote: Sign up for mercatox - https://mercatox.com/?referrer=146282
Join My Bitconnect Squad here: https://bitconnect.co/?ref=brandonyoung1
These are affiliate links. So I will get a small commission if you press them :).
on this channel i talk about cryptocurrency and how to make multiple streams of income

rebuttal.rebuttal: The referral disclosure itself does not neutralize the commercial pressure: it confirms that clicking the links benefits the presenter. The audience is simultaneously exposed to an exchange sign-up, a cryptocurrency purchase route, and income framing. That combination makes the video function as monetized token-purchase promotion, even if it avoids an explicit numerical return promise.

citations.quote: These are affiliate links. So I will get a small commission if you press them :).
now mercatox is a very good alternative to buy altcoins that Binance does not have on their system

true_side_reply.rebuttal: These are visible commercial and cryptocurrency signals, but they do not establish token appreciation, dividends, or any promised return. The affiliate statement is an explicit disclosure, not concealed compensation. The screen walkthrough shows balances, deposit mechanics, and a buy form, while the narration says the amount depends on how much Bitcoin the viewer has; no profit outcome is claimed.

citations.quote: These are affiliate links. So I will get a small commission if you press them :).
depending on how much Bitcoin you have in your account you can put in the amount that you want to buy

opening.argument: Although presented as a tutorial, the video operates as a promotional funnel. It identifies the exchange as a preferred alternative, tells viewers where to obtain Bitcoin, supplies a registration link, demonstrates the deposit and trade process, and closes by asking for subscriptions while invoking multiple income streams. The description adds a Bitconnect squad invitation and states that link clicks generate commission. This combination turns operational guidance into audience acquisition and referral promotion, with the educational format lending credibility to the solicitation.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The reference description of an ordinary tutorial overlooks how many promotional steps surround the instruction. Viewers are directed to an exchange, told to use a supplied link, encouraged to pursue income, and invited into a named squad. The disclosure may reveal one commission, but it does not make the broader funnel non-promotional or explain the relationship between the income framing and the requested participation.

citations.quote: on this channel i talk about cryptocurrency and how to make multiple streams of income
ALL OF MY VIDEOS ARE BASED SOLELY UPON MY OWN EXPERIENCES AND OPINIONS

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Promotion and referral compensation do not by themselves establish a recruitment-based income scheme. The video does not describe downlines, team qualification, commissions from recruits, or tiered participation. The Bitconnect invitation is present, but the demonstrated activity remains buying Dogecoin through an exchange, and the disclosed commission is tied to link clicks rather than a recruitment structure.
